name: Blonney
bio: Archetype: ST DPT, AoE DPT, Crit-Based. ⌽ Skill 1 has innately-increased Crit Rate/DMG; additonal buffs locked behind Ult. ⌽ Skill 2 can inflict [Confusion]. ⌽ Both skills have relatively high ST damage mods. ⌽ Can help generate crits for herself with semi-consistent ST [Confusion]. ⌽ Synergy: Crit-oriented units and Crit-buffers (Lorelei, Mercuria, Argus, etc.)
